page.notes: Catchword "tàm" is printed below the last line at bottom right. The drop-cap letter at the start of "Libentissime" looks like a large I, which is most likely L; marked with [?]. "Sacerdotes Imperatoribus esse superiores" and the opening continuation sentence are set in italic; the continuation sentence is likely italic in full.
